mapper.sql: emp53_biz_trip_id AS bizTripId , CONCAT(f_emp_kor_nm(emp53_person_id) ,'('||f_get_empTrans(emp53_person_id, emp53_start_date::date, 'org_code_nm')||')') AS personInfo , emp53_start_date AS startDate , emp53_close_date AS closeDate , f_cdnm('BizTripCode', emp53_biz_trip_cd, emp53_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS bizTripName , emp53_destination AS destination , emp53_purpose AS purpose , emp53_num AS num , emp53_companion AS companion , emp53_appr_id AS apprId , apr01.apr01_status_cd AS apprStatusCode , f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr01.apr01_status_cd, emp53_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS apprStatusName , emp53_result_appr_id AS resultApprId , apr02.apr01_status_cd AS resultApprStatusCode , f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr02.apr01_status_cd, emp53_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS resultApprStatusName , emp53_result_skip_yn AS resultSkipYn , emp53_skip_reason AS skipReason
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM emp53_biz_trip LEFT OUTER JOIN apr01_appr apr01 ON apr01.apr01_appr_id = emp53_appr_id LEFT OUTER JOIN apr01_appr apr02 ON apr02.apr01_appr_id = emp53_result_appr_id WHERE emp53_company_id = #{companyId} AND emp53_start_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{closeDate} AND COALESCE(apr01.apr01_status_cd, '99') != '99'
AND COALESCE(apr02.apr01_status_cd, '99') != '30' AND COALESCE(emp53_result_skip_yn,'false') != 'true'
AND UPPER(CONCAT(f_get_empTrans(emp53_person_id, emp53_start_date::date, 'org_code_nm'), f_emp_kor_nm(emp53_person_id), emp53_destination, emp53_purpose)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText}) ORDER BY emp53_start_date DESC
mapper.sql: emp53_biz_trip_id AS bizTripId , emp53_start_date AS startDate , emp53_close_date AS closeDate , emp53_biz_trip_cd AS bizTripCode , f_cdnm('BizTripCode', emp53_biz_trip_cd, emp53_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS bizTripName , emp53_destination AS destination , emp53_purpose AS purpose , emp53_num AS num , emp53_companion AS companion , emp53_note AS note , emp53_appr_id AS apprId , apr01.apr01_status_cd AS apprStatusCode , f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr01.apr01_status_cd, emp53_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS apprStatusName , emp53_result_appr_id AS resultApprId , apr02.apr01_status_cd AS resultApprStatusCode , f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr02.apr01_status_cd, emp53_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS resultApprStatusName , (COALESCE(emp53_public_yn,'false') = 'true') AS publicYn , CASE WHEN COALESCE(emp53_public_yn,'false') = 'true' THEN '전체공개' ELSE ( SELECT (SELECT CASE WHEN emp56_share_cd = '1' THEN f_emp_kor_nm(emp56_person_id) ELSE f_org_nm(emp56_org_id, f_today()) END FROM emp56_share WHERE emp56_parent_id = emp53_biz_trip_id ORDER BY emp56_share_cd DESC LIMIT 1) ||(CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN '' ELSE ' 외 '|| COUNT(*)-1 END) FROM emp56_share WHERE emp56_parent_id = emp53_biz_trip_id ) END AS shareInfo
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO emp53_biz_trip (emp53_biz_trip_id, emp53_company_id, emp53_person_id, emp53_start_date, emp53_close_date, emp53_biz_trip_cd, emp53_destination, emp53_purpose, emp53_num, emp53_companion, emp53_note, emp53_public_yn) VALUES (#{bizTripId}, #{companyId}, #{personId}, #{req.startDate}, #{req.closeDate}, #{req.bizTripCode}, #{req.destination}, #{req.purpose}, #{req.num}, #{req.companion}, #{req.note}, CAST(#{req.publicYn} AS VARCHAR))
mapper.update: UPDATE emp53_biz_trip SET emp53_start_date = #{req.startDate}, emp53_close_date = #{req.closeDate}, emp53_biz_trip_cd = #{req.bizTripCode}, emp53_destination = #{req.destination}, emp53_purpose = #{req.purpose}, emp53_num = #{req.num}, emp53_companion = #{req.companion}, emp53_note = #{req.note}, emp53_public_yn = CAST(#{req.publicYn} AS VARCHAR) WHERE emp53_biz_trip_id = #{bizTripId} AND emp53_company_id = #{companyId} AND emp53_person_id = #{personId}
